reviews.text:
I moved to this area and was able to meet Ratnel-san. From the initial consultation, I was impressed by her polite and cheerful personality!

Thank you so much for visiting 10 times, even in the intense heat. Your reports were incredibly detailed, and I was amazed by the high quality of the photos and videos! The photos of the lively cats are a treasure.

You not only took care of feeding and litter box maintenance within the limited time, but also included playtime, allowing me to enjoy my vacation with peace of mind.

I look forward to continuing our relationship for many years to come!

Whenever I travel, I always entrust my beloved cat to Ratnel. Since they come to my home, I have complete confidence in their staff. While I'm away, I receive photo and video updates via LINE. Their care is meticulous, and they shower my cat with affection, so I can leave with peace of mind. It's best to book early, especially during peak seasons. They're very popular!

This was my first time using a guinea pig sitting service, and I felt completely at ease!

During the pre-service consultation, the sitter carefully took notes while demonstrating how to clean the cage, and clearly explained all the points they needed to confirm, which made me feel very confident in their service.

During the sitting, they sent me many photos and videos, all beautifully taken, which gave me peace of mind knowing how my guinea pig was doing while I was away. Their love for animals was also very evident!

Thanks to them, my guinea pig was even more relaxed than I expected.

They were friendly and kind throughout our interaction; a truly wonderful person!

They are a fantastic pet sitter, and I would highly recommend them to anyone who owns small animals like guinea pigs!

From the initial consultation, they played with the cats and gave them treats to help them bond, and I could really feel their love for them!
On the day of the pet sitting, they gave me a detailed report from the moment they entered the room until the cats' behavior, which put my mind at ease.
I would definitely like to request their services again!

I always rely on their services when I travel or visit my family.

During the initial consultation, they asked me detailed questions about things like the amount and proportion of food, heating and cooling, and whether I wanted the curtains open or closed, which put me at ease.

During the pet-sitting, they sent me lots of videos and photos, and their voice in the videos is so gentle; it's clear they treat my cat with love. ☺️

My cat initially froze under the bed, but recently they've started chatting and eating treats directly, so they seem to be gradually getting used to me.

They are a very trustworthy person, and I recommend them with confidence!

This is a trustworthy sitter who provides very thorough reports, communication, and consultations. I feel at ease because they provide video reports of everything, from unlocking the door and entering the room, to how the pet is doing while I'm out, and even when they leave and lock the doors and windows.

Whenever I'm away from home, I always ask them to take care of my dogs and cats. During the sitting, they send me real-time videos along with detailed comments about feeding, playing, and walks, so I feel at ease leaving them in their care even when I'm traveling. They always sit with care and attention from the dogs' and cats' perspective, and even my super shy dogs and cats seem to trust and become attached to them, which is a great help.

I request cat sitting for my three cats on the middle day when I'm away for two nights or more.

They take very good care of them.

They also provide timely updates on the cats' well-being via LINE, including photos and videos.

They play with the cats a lot, and they seem to have a great time! The photos they send are wonderful.

Receiving photos that capture their charm, from dynamic poses to dramatically cute expressions, is one of the things I look forward to when requesting cat sitting.

I live with one cat, and since I first asked you to come and help me about three years ago, you've come every time I visit home.

My cat is very shy, but it seems to have warmed up to me now ^^♪
When I received a message from you saying how happy it was that your cat saw you off for the first time when you finished sitting, it made me so happy too.

You always send me lots of photos and videos.
You can tell that you love and cherish your cat, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in your care.
You also send me videos of you locking the door when you leave, so I can trust you.

I'd definitely like to ask you to continue using my services in the future ^^

The sitter sends videos and photos of my cats, so I can immediately see that they are doing well, which is very reassuring. She's a pet sitter who truly understands what a pet owner needs. Thanks to Ms. Ratnel, I can regularly take care of my country garden.

We were assisted by Ms. Miyamoto from the staff.

We were very grateful that she was able to accommodate our last-minute request.

She sends us videos and photos as soon as she arrives. The photos are so well taken, capturing our child's cuteness, that it's become one of the highlights of our trip, and our child eagerly awaits the sitter's arrival. When there weren't any toys that our child would enjoy, she brought handmade toys to play with, showing her love for animals, and we felt completely at ease leaving our child in her care.

When I travel, I request cat sitting for my three cats. Initially, I requested 30 minutes, but I realized that wasn't enough, so now I request 45 minutes.

The reports arrive in real time, which initially surprised me with the constant notifications, but I've gotten used to it now and it's not a problem.

The videos clearly show the abundant love and care that goes into each cat, and it always warms my heart.

Also, I really appreciate that they understand each cat's personality so well and play with even the more independent cat who tends to keep her distance from the other two.

I know it's not their main job and they don't have to do it if they don't want to, but I would be grateful if they could do a quick vacuum on the last day. (The cat sitter I used before moving to Setagaya even watered the plants and did a little cleaning! 😭)

Thank you so much for your continued support!

When we ask Ms. Ratner to take care of our cats, she takes meticulous care of every detail, keeps us updated via LINE, and is very thorough with appointments and key handover, so we can leave everything to her with peace of mind. Most importantly, our cats seem to enjoy being around her. That's the most important thing!

Initially, I was honestly anxious about entrusting my cat to someone else, but I was impressed by the thorough consultation and, most importantly, by the fact that my timid cat wasn't very scared.

I often ask them to look after my cat for two nights while I'm away on business trips or vacations, and they always provide real-time updates with lots of videos and photos, so I can rest assured knowing my cat is doing well even when I'm away.

They're actually much better at playing with my cat than I am; I'd love to ask them for a lesson sometime!

My cat seems to be able to stay home alone without stress, thanks to all the playtime and pampering.

They also give advice on feeding, litter box management, and eye discharge, and, although it's an unusual situation, they even provided emergency assistance when a family member living far away fell ill, which I was incredibly grateful for.

They are always so thoughtful and a truly trustworthy cat sitter!

Whenever we are away on vacation, you take care of our beloved cat. Our family (and our cat!) have absolute trust in this loving cat sitter 🥰
You send us videos and photos (with dynamic and perfectly angled shots! 😆) of our cat playing with all her might in real time, giving us the peace of mind that comes from being so close, even when we're far away. We are always so grateful.
You also give us advice based on your deep understanding of cats, which has given us a chance to re-evaluate our cat's living environment.
We are truly glad we found LaToNeRu. We look forward to continuing to work with you in the future 🐈‍⬛💕

While walking my toy poodle, I lost my balance on a slope and fractured my right ankle. I was looking for someone to walk my dog ​​for me and found Ratnel. It was a sudden and difficult situation, so I was very grateful for their prompt response. During our first meeting, they took ample time to understand my dog's personality and habits, which put me at ease. My dog ​​quickly warmed up to them and looked forward to our daily walks. Although they said they weren't a professional trainer, they helped correct my dog's jumping behavior and got him used to the bicycle cover he was afraid of during walks. They also used treats to practice tricks, which made the walks enjoyable for my dog. They send videos and photos during walks, so I can clearly see how happy my dog ​​is.

I will be requesting your dog walking services again when my dog ​​has surgery scheduled.

I used this service for the first time for a trip. I was a little worried because I had no prior experience with pet sitting, but the pre-service consultation was thorough, and they even sent videos and photos during the visit, so I felt completely at ease!

My cat is quite timid, but it seems she was able to play without hiding, which was great. It was very easy to use, and I would definitely like to use their services again if the opportunity arises. Thank you!

This was my first time using a sitter, so I was a little worried, but now I'm so glad I chose LaToNeRu!
They arranged early morning and evening walks for midsummer walks, and when it rained and we couldn't take our dog for a walk, they played with various toys for us.
I'm so grateful for their flexibility.
They provide ample updates with lots of photos, and there are so many pictures of my dog's happy face, lol, so I can leave my dog ​​in their care with peace of mind.
I definitely recommend this sitter!

This pet sitter is incredibly trustworthy!

I entrust my beloved dog to them. 🐶

The first meeting was a face-to-face introduction, and from that moment, my dog ​​immediately warmed up to them. I felt they were a true professional. Honestly, before using a pet sitter, I was a little hesitant about entrusting my keys to them, but after meeting them, I felt immediately at ease and confident that they were the right person.

On the day of the sitting, they share many videos and photos of my dog's activities from entry to exit, which gives me peace of mind even when I'm away, and seeing my dog's smile is incredibly comforting.

My dog ​​loves walks, and they take him for long, enjoyable walks. On hot days, they don't push him too hard and let him play happily indoors, so I appreciate their ability to adapt to the situation.

I previously left my dog ​​at a pet hotel, but the change of environment seemed to stress him out, and he ended up with diarrhea... I felt so sorry for him.

Since then, I've wanted my dog ​​to be in a familiar environment and looked after by someone I trust, so I've started using a pet sitter.

If you're hesitating, I'd definitely encourage you to give it a try!

I always feel at ease when I ask for your help. 🙏
My dog ​​has grown attached to you thanks to your thorough reports and loving interactions. 🐈
I'm also happy that you take such adorable photos. ♡

We asked Latnell to look after our two cats for three days.
Not only did they provide food, litter box, and water, but they also played with them to their heart's content with toys and sent us detailed videos and photos of their activities. The cats seemed to be having so much fun, so we were able to enjoy our trip with peace of mind.
One time they vomited up, but they even cleaned it up perfectly.
I think they had carefully planned their visit times to coincide with our departure and return times.
Thank you so much for your meticulous care. Even our extremely shy cats have become big fans of Latnell!

I used a pet sitter for the first time to care for my shy brothers. Ms. Miyamoto was assigned to my cats. From the initial consultation, she listened very carefully to my cats' personalities, which put me at ease. She also gave me a clear picture of what I needed to prepare. Her accurate advice, backed by experience and knowledge, regarding things like litter boxes and water bowls was very reassuring, and above all, her respectful way of speaking made me feel very confident.

On the day of the appointment, she sent me many before-and-after photos and videos. My brothers are shy, so they often don't come out when guests arrive... I wondered if I'd even get to see their faces, but with gentle words and just the right amount of distance, I saw them happily eating treats! So happy!

Ms. Miyamoto appeared quickly, efficiently cared for my cats, maintained an appropriate relationship, showered them with love, and then left as quickly as the wind. I will definitely ask Ratnel to sitter my cats again in the future.
This sitter has an overwhelming love for pets.

When we're away from home for two nights or more for travel or visiting family, we entrust our two cats to this service.
Initially, I was hesitant about letting a stranger into our home, but after meeting them during the initial consultation, my daughter, the cats, and I were all completely charmed by their wonderful personality. They are far more knowledgeable about animals than I am, and I appreciate that they notice any potential hazards in our home.
They send us a report with videos and photos after each visit, and their voice when speaking to the cats is so gentle that it makes me feel confident that they are the right person! My daughter envies the cats and says, "I wish they could take care of me too!" every time a video arrives.
Many of the photos attached to the report capture moments I couldn't have taken myself, and I personally think it's worth having them come just for those photos!
We would definitely like to request their services again for our next trip or visit home.

I always ask her to sit for my two cats. My shy cats have become completely attached to me and are now clinging to me, and I'm so happy to save the cute photos she sends me. She's qualified and has a wealth of specialized knowledge, so I can feel at ease even when I'm away.

I always ask them to take care of my pets when I travel. As everyone says, they are a very reliable pet sitter that I can entrust my pets to with complete peace of mind. I have a cat, and she doesn't usually play much, but when the sitter comes, she becomes incredibly energetic, so I would like to ask them to take care of her pets a few times a year to help her get enough exercise.

When I go back home or travel, I ask someone to look after my two cats. At a pet hotel, I once had a situation where my cats weren't used to the environment, and they weren't eating or urinating much, which may have been due to compatibility issues with the hotel, so I've been using a sitter ever since.
LaToNeRu reports to me a lot in real time, and I feel at ease knowing how the cats are doing, as if I'm there with them. Their photos are also taken from angles I'm not used to taking myself (which is also cute), so I think they're a great sitter! I hope to continue using their services.

I asked for a sitter to sit my beloved cat for three days while I was traveling!
Right from the meeting, they were very kind and provided detailed updates with photos and videos every day ♡
My cat seemed so at ease with the sitter there, so I'm really glad I asked them to do it!
They even told my cat how much they loved him, and they were so loving and caring!
I'd definitely hire them again ♡
I was surprised at how shy cats have become so attached to me. Whenever I ask for a sitter, she always sends me beautiful photos, which I always save. I can trust her!

I've been using a cockatiel sitting service for about four years now, whenever I travel or go on business trips.
The same person is usually assigned to my bird each time, so it's completely used to them. Even when I'm away, it eats well, doesn't lose weight, and remains calm.

During the sitting, they provide detailed reports with photos, sharing information about the bird's health and any small observations, which is very reassuring.

Above all, I'm incredibly grateful that they let the bird out of its cage to play; I'm sure the bird enjoys it every time.

They have a friendly and approachable demeanor, and their flexibility is always a great help.

Their care is clearly done with a love for animals, and they are a valuable resource that I can entrust my bird to with complete confidence.
